mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lms.tb_test ( sub_seq, test_name, duration, start_time, end_time, status, reg_id, reg_date ) VALUES ( #{subSeq}, #{testName}, #{duration}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{regId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT test_seq, sub_seq, test_name, duration, start_time, end_time, status, reg_id, reg_date, update_id, update_date FROM lms.tb_test WHERE sub_seq = #{subSeq} ORDER BY test_seq DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE lms.tb_test SET test_name = #{testName}, duration = #{duration}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_id = #{updateId}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE test_seq = #{testSeq}
